# Variable `BB_NUMBER_PARSE_THREADS`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

See BB_NUMBER_PARSE_THREADS in the BitBake manual.

## BitBake User Manual

Sets the number of threads BitBake uses when parsing. By default, the number of threads is equal to the number of cores on the system.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-BB_NUMBER_PARSE_THREADS , https://docs.yoctoproject.org/bitbake/2.8/bitbake-user-manual/bitbake-user-manual-ref-variables.html#term-BB_NUMBER_PARSE_THREADS
